description:
**Divergence**: the canonical jmap-mail-server places its FaultyBackend test harness in tests/common/mod.rs:58 and the canonical AGENTS.md banner says siblings 'mirror its shape'. Actual placements across 7 siblings:

| Crate | FaultyBackend placement |
|---|---|
| mail-server (canonical) | tests/common/mod.rs:58 |
| chat-server | tests/common/mod.rs:40 (matches canonical; AGENTS.md:74-102 documents two extra wrappers IdentityBackend + TrackingBackend) |
| filenode-server | INLINE in src/filenode.rs:1754 — single #[cfg(test)] mod |
| calendars-server | INLINE THREE TIMES — src/calendar.rs:608, src/event.rs:2420, src/event.rs:2606, src/principal.rs:320 |
| tasks-server | NONE |
| contacts-server | NONE |
| metadata-server | NONE |
| sharing-server | NONE |

**Caller-observable / maintainer effect**: four extension-server siblings cannot exercise the BackendSetError::Other redaction contract that mail-server's canonical tests (tests/integration.rs:5787-5873) assert against. A backend that violates the redaction contract in tasks-server / contacts-server / metadata-server / sharing-server would not be caught by any test in this workspace. The inlining in calendars-server (three separate definitions of the same struct) and filenode-server (one inline definition) is also undocumented divergence from the canonical's 'live in tests/common/mod.rs' pattern, and the three calendars copies risk drifting apart from each other on a future contributor's update.

**Documented vs undocumented**: chat-server documents its extensions in AGENTS.md:74-102. The four absent-FaultyBackend siblings and the calendars/filenode inline-copies have no recorded justification anywhere. The propagation rule says divergence is a regression 'unless documented' — these are undocumented regressions.

**Fix sequence** (file as a sweep epic with child beads):
(a) Consolidate calendars-server's three inline FaultyBackend defs into tests/common/mod.rs, matching canonical shape.
(b) Move filenode-server's inline FaultyBackend into tests/common/mod.rs, matching canonical shape.
(c) Add a FaultyBackend to tasks-server, contacts-server, metadata-server, sharing-server tests/common/mod.rs matching canonical shape.
(d) Port the canonical redaction-contract assertions from crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/integration.rs:5790-5873 to each sibling's integration tests.
title: Workspace: FaultyBackend placement diverges across 8 extension-server siblings (canonical: tests/common/mod.rs; calendars: 3 inline copies; 4 siblings: none at all)
